data.long_meaning: Harshada is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Harsham’ which means to cause joy or happiness. The name Harshada is a feminine form and is often used to denote a joyful, happy or blissful woman. The name Harshada carries the meaning “Happy, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harshada usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
